name: Chaos Dorloto
source:
The main antagonist of the 2nd main quest's episode 5 "Pinocchio Story Zone".

A living doll crafted by Dorloto in an attempt to create a copy of herself, Chaos Dorloto was discarded for being imperfect, and now seeks to turn all the residents from Pinocchio's world into dolls.
